title: Book 1, Aphorisms 116–130
author: Francis Bacon
source: *Novum Organum*, Book 1, Aphorisms 116–130, in the English translation edited by Joseph Devey (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1902), 90–107. Bacon published the *Novum Organum* in Latin in 1620.
summary: Bacon answers the objections his method may meet, disclaiming any new sect, any haste for works over light, and any wish to abolish the arts, and closes with the dignity of inventions and of the empire of man over nature, to be recovered through the arts and sciences.
